issues.description: The solution implementation of set_pixel computes the target address and then adds an extra constant offset (+4) before writing the pixel (add eax, 4). This causes the subroutine to write to the next pixel (off-by-one pixel) instead of the pixel at (x,y). This contradicts the problem specification (which requires writing the pixel at the computed address) and also contradicts the address calculation performed elsewhere in the solution (main computes display_start + (y*7680 + x*4) without any additional +4).
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the stray 'add eax, 4' in set_pixel and ensure the address calculation matches display_start + (y*1920 + x) * 4. Concretely, compute offset = x*4 + y*7680, add display_start to the offset, and write the color to [address]. This makes set_pixel consistent with the calculation used in main and with the problem specification.
